title: Nell Waits Out the Wet
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, zz, qu, ch added, 32-sound stage.

pages.brief: Nell the yellow and black bee flying low over a wooden bird table in a garden.
Rain beginning to fall over the bird table, Nell looking unhappy in the open.
Nell the bee darting fast into a small wooden box fixed under the bird table roof.
Nell the bee sitting still inside the small wooden box, dry, rain falling outside.
Nell the bee sitting beside a small brown beetle inside the box, facing each other.
Nell the bee and the small beetle both settled down quietly inside the box, eyes closed.
Bright sunshine over the bird table now, raindrops still on the roof but the rain stopped.
Nell the bee flying happily out of the box and up above the bird table into the sun.
